<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This registration statement on Form 10 incorporates by reference information contained in (a)&nbsp;the proxy statement/prospectus statement of
Gentherm Incorporated (&#8220;Gentherm&#8221;) filed as Exhibit 99.1 hereto (the &#8220;Information Statement&#8221;), which is serving as an information statement for Platinum SpinCo Inc. (&#8220;SpinCo&#8221;), (b) the Annual Report on Form <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K</FONT> of Gentherm for the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2025 filed as Exhibit 99.2 hereto (the &#8220;Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K&#8221;),</FONT> (c) the Quarterly Report on Form <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q</FONT> of Gentherm for the quarterly period ended March&nbsp;31, 2026, filed as Exhibit 99.3 hereto (the &#8220;Q1 Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q&#8221;),</FONT> (d) the Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q of
Gentherm for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026, filed as Exhibit 99.4 hereto (the &#8220;Q2 Form 10-Q&#8221; and together with the Q1 Form 10-Q, the &#8220;Form 10-Qs&#8221;) and (e)&nbsp;the definitive proxy statement on Schedule 14A of
Gentherm for its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders filed as Exhibit 99.5 hereto (the &#8220;Gentherm Proxy Statement&#8221;), which includes the information referenced in Part III of the Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K</FONT> filed as
Exhibit 99.2 hereto. None of the information contained in the Information Statement, the Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K,</FONT> the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Form&nbsp;10-Qs</FONT> or the Gentherm Proxy Statement shall be
incorporated by reference herein or deemed to be a part hereof unless such information is specifically incorporated by reference. </P>  <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Item&#8201;1.

Section&nbsp;4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#8220;Securities Act&#8221;). Platinum SpinCo Inc. did not register the issuance of the issued shares under the Securities Act because such issuance did not constitute a public
offering. </P>
